opportunities.name: Dinner plan: restaurant lookup + recipe lookup + note
opportunities.description: For a cuisine/area, find a top restaurant on OpenTable, find the matching recipe on Allrecipes, and save a combined dinner note in Notes.
steps: On OpenTable, search the cuisine+area query
Open the top restaurant result and read rating, price, area
On Allrecipes, search the dish name
Open the top recipe and read its cook time
In Notes, add 'Dinner: out at <restaurant> (<rating>, <price>, <area>) or cook <recipe> (<time>)'

instances.values: Italian Islington; lasagna -> Terra Rossa / Creamy Chicken Lasagna
Thai Soho; pad thai -> Thai Tho - Soho / Pad Thai
Indian Shoreditch; chicken tikka masala -> SPICE SLICE Shoreditch

opportunities.description: For a city and a weekend date, look up the city on Wikipedia, search Booking.com for a one-night stay, and save a stopover note with hotel, price and population.
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and note the population
On Booking.com enter the destination, pick the suggestion
Click Search and open the top property

instances.values: Reims, Dec 19-20, Best Western Premier Hotel de la Paix €204

opportunities.name: Call planning: timezone + weather + draft email
opportunities.description: For a city, check local time on timeanddate and the 10-day forecast on Weather.com, then draft an email to family about a call, then discard.
steps: Search the city on timeanddate and open the result to read local time and offset
On Weather.com search the city and open the 10 Day forecast
In mail compose a new message to family@example.com
Write body with local time, offset to Lille and forecast
